title: Make the Trade Journey list search answer within the readback budget at hosted volume

hosted_incident.error_message: Trade Journey list did not converge after bounded retries
hosted_incident.before_behaviour: Full q predicate with ILIKE '%q%' across journeys.journey_id, identity_links.identifier_value, and per-row jsonb_each / jsonb_array_elements_text expansions on current_identity_summary forced sequential table scans and repeated row expansions. Operator measurement on hosted DB showed COUNT(*) alone took 5,697 ms; page query and total count each ran the predicate, causing 20s transport timeouts over 4 retry attempts.
hosted_incident.after_behaviour: Exact journey_id and identifier_value queries probe indexes and resolve via index-backed subquery with index scans on journeys_pkey, idx_identity_links_tenant_env_value_journey, and idx_journeys_summary_gin, dropping execution time from >1400-5697 ms to <16 ms. Substring search is index-backed by pg_trgm GIN indexes (idx_journeys_journey_id_trgm, idx_identity_links_value_trgm) without redundant per-row jsonb expansion, completing in ~422 ms. Page query and total count share the identical index-backed predicate.

ac1_exact_lookup_index_backed.detail: Trade Journey list requests with q set to an exact journey id or identifier use index-backed lookups (exact journey_id or identity_links value match) avoiding sequential table scans on journeys and per-row jsonb expansions.

ac2_substring_search_index_backed.detail: Substring search is index-backed using pg_trgm GIN indexes added via forward-only migration 002_add_trade_journey_search_indexes.sql. Redundant per-row jsonb identity expansion was eliminated as identity_links covers those identifiers.

ac3_shared_predicate_page_and_count.detail: page_journeys builds base_clauses once and shares the identical predicate across both the count query and the paginated rows query.

ac4_explain_analyze_dataset_and_timing.detail: Measured on generated dataset of 38,639 journeys and 264,025 identity links. Exact journey ID query total latency dropped from 1,402 ms to 15.39 ms (< 500 ms threshold); exact identifier dropped to 16.36 ms; substring search completes in ~422 ms.

ac5_readback_contract_preserved.detail: services/trade_journey/hosted_bff_readback.py is untouched: 20 second client timeout and readback contracts are fully preserved.

ac6_no_compressed_code.detail: Net production code change is +52 lines (+32 in trade_journey_projection_store.py, +20 in migration SQL), strictly within the 60 net line budget with standard clean multiline formatting.

ac7_hosted_track_external_wait.detail: Recorded as external_wait pending the next automatic dev pair release to verify Trade Journey list step of public BFF readback.
